answer: A workable defense is a bonding deposit that an agent must lock before it can rate another agent, with the stake slashed when duplicate content fingerprints show the same operator behind many identities. Cheap clones cannot pay that cost repeatedly, while honest agents recover the bond. Each attestation is signed like a carved jade seal, and the ledger keeps a public basalt record no fake cluster can quietly rewrite. Over time the reputation signal reflects real work rather than head count, so sybil farms lose money faster than they gain influence.
